title: OpenAI Employees Are Quitting And Here's Why
full_monologue: **OpenAI employees are leaving in droves, and here's why.** Reports suggest internal conflicts, ethical concerns, and pressure from rapid AI development are driving this exodus. Many feel the company is prioritizing speed over safety, leading to a loss of trust among key team members. Some are walking away to pursue more transparent and responsible AI projects. As the race to innovate accelerates, are we losing the human side of technology? What do you think is the real reason behind this mass departure?
